name: glpi-plugins/glpiticketreportsign
description: GLPI 10-12 plugin: per-ticket PDF report with embedded follow-ups, solutions and a hand-drawn signature.
//: setasign/fpdf and chillerlan/php-qrcode are NOT loaded from a root vendor/ — setup.php require_once's pdf/fpdf.php and qrcode/vendor/autoload.php directly, matching the actual bundled copies on disk, so audit tooling sees no gap between what's installed and what's declared. This top-level composer.json exists so a root-level `composer audit`/`composer show` can actually see them (they were previously invisible to any tool that doesn't know to look inside pdf/ and qrcode/vendor/chillerlan/ for their own nested composer.json files) — running `composer install` here is unnecessary for the plugin to work, since both are already present. The two nested chillerlan composer.json files have their own require.php widened from the upstream ^7.2 (see the comment there) so this resolves at all against the plugin's own php:>=8.2 floor.
